status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 물풀이 우거진 늪과 저수지, 강 하류

months.note: 한강 하류와 낙동강 유역에서 11월부터 3월까지 기록되며, 여름에도 드물게 남은 개체가 기록된다.

summary: 해마다 수천 마리가 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 낙동강 유역의 우포늪과 주남저수지, 임진강과 한강 하류 등에서 겨울을 난다. 탁 트인 논밭에서 주로 먹이를 찾는 큰기러기와 달리 늪에서 먹이를 찾는 일이 많으며, 긴 목과 부리로 줄·마름 같은 물풀의 뿌리줄기와 씨를 먹는다. 울음소리는 큰기러기보다 훨씬 낮고 굵다. 야쿠티야와 캄차카반도 등 시베리아 동부의 타이가 지대에서 번식하며, 일본에서 겨울을 나는 큰기러기 무리는 대부분 이 아종이다.

art.subject: Taiga Bean Goose of the subspecies Anser fabalis middendorffi, adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korea in winter: head and upper neck warm brown, darkest on the crown and around the bill base, the long neck slightly paler and grading into the pale grey-brown breast; mantle and wing coverts grey-brown with pale buff fringes forming neat transverse bars; belly pale grey-brown; flanks darker brown with pale bars and a white line along their upper edge; vent, undertail coverts and a narrow band of uppertail coverts white; tail dark grey-brown with a white tip. Long black bill with a narrow orange band near the tip and a black nail; dark brown eye; bright orange legs.
art.pose: standing on the muddy edge of a reservoir with its long neck held upright, side view, the long bill shown in clear profile
art.scene: Korean winter: the shallow margin of a wide reservoir with dry reeds and harvested rice fields beyond, low soft winter light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing at the water's edge: long, wedge-shaped warm brown head with a gently sloping forehead, long upright neck grading into a pale grey-brown breast, grey-brown upperparts barred by pale fringes, barred brown flanks with a white upper edge, white vent, long slender black bill with a narrow orange band near the tip, orange legs

adult, head detail in side profile: long, fairly slender black bill about as long as the head, with a narrow orange band just behind the black nail, the gently sloping forehead running almost straight into the culmen to give a long, wedge-shaped, almost swan-like profile; warm brown head with no white at the bill base, dark brown eye
art.build: The largest form of bean goose: a big, long-necked grey-brown goose, much larger than a Mallard and clearly bigger, longer-necked and longer-billed than Tundra Bean Goose. Head long with a gently sloping forehead, giving a long, wedge-shaped, almost swan-like profile. Bill long and fairly slender, about as long as the head, black with an orange band before the tip. Legs orange, medium length. In flight long-necked, with dark upperwings and a narrow white band across the uppertail coverts above the dark tail.
avoid: Do not paint a short, deep-based bill with a steep forehead; that is Tundra Bean Goose, the common bean goose in Korea.
Do not paint a white forehead blaze or black belly bars; those belong to Greater White-fronted Goose (Anser albifrons).
Do not paint pink on the bill or pink legs; the bill band and the legs are orange.
Do not paint a pale grey head and neck or a pale grey forewing like Greylag Goose; the head and neck are dark brown.
